target_customer: Shippers, 3PLs and carriers in Latin American road freight (originally digital lenders in Latin America)
problem: Tendering and tracking loads runs on emails, calls and WhatsApp messages, so ops teams spend their time copying load details and chasing carriers and drivers.
business_model: B2B SaaS AI agent for logistics operations; pricing not stated
product_category: AI agent for freight tendering and shipment monitoring

founders.name: Daniel Akle Carranza
prior_employers: Tala (GM, per the YC launch post)

founders.name: Antonio Longoria
education: Mechanical engineer by training, self-taught full-stack developer

technical_complexity.rationale: At the batch the product was a lender data network, then a message parsing and matching agent. Reading unstructured WhatsApp and email into load data was feasible but not trivial for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: The agent works on top of existing email, WhatsApp and TMS tools, so integrations help but the approach is copyable by other freight AI entrants.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found describing an incumbent response. Many freight AI entrants appeared later according to search results, but those are not dated near the batch.

market_need_then: The YC launch post at the batch targeted LATAM digital lenders fighting fraud and default. Demand evidence for the later freight use case is the company's own claim that tendering runs on messages.

branding.domain_note: Uses trebu.ai per the company site; no domain history found.

identity.logo: not described in any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Spanish language product page, plain and operational

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community material about the brand was found; search for the name returned only generic naming articles.

pivots.from: Data sharing network to help LATAM lenders fight fraud and default (YC launch, Aug 2022)
pivots.to: AI coworker for freight tendering and shipment monitoring
pivots.why: Not stated in any source found.

outcome_analysis: Trebu is listed as active with a team of 5. Sources show a change from a lender data network at the batch to a freight and logistics AI agent, with no dated pivot reason. No outcome news such as an acquisition, shutdown or layoffs was found, and funding beyond aggregator entries is unknown, so the story is unclear.
notes: Funding is unverified: Caplight shows about $500K from YC in Sep 2022 and about $1M total, and VCBacked lists YC, Latitud, Astraecho Capital and Nazca Ventures, both aggregators with inconsistent entries, so no round is recorded. No dated competitors for the lender data network were found; the freight competitors seen in search (Nuvocargo, Cargado, Flete.com) are from 2025 to 2026 pages and are excluded. YC jobs page snippet gave a freight style description that differs from the batch launch post. Search for the name and brand found nothing. Completeness pass: two seed entries, 2022-09-07 (Caplight, no amount shown on the page) and 2024-01 (VCBacked, investors listed), each rest on a single database; they may overlap. Earlier notes cite Caplight at about 500K and 1M total, which could not be re-confirmed.
